definition.title: Expand separable expressions
definition.subtitle: Learn, understand, and use a Mandarin pattern.
definition.context: Use the introduced pattern in a bounded sentence. Other wording may be valid Chinese; this task checks this pattern and these words.

blocks.text: Some verb-object words permit internal aspect or duration. Result compounds follow different constraints: learn each expression instead of separating every two-character verb alike. Resultative compounds do not accept arbitrary noun modifiers inside them; they can allow potential 得/不 between verb and result, as in 分得开 versus 分不开. This differs from inserting an object modifier into a verb-object expression.

examples.pinyin: tā xǐ le yī gè zǎo 。
zhè liǎng gè ， wǒ fēn de kāi 。
zhè liǎng gè ， wǒ fēn bù kāi 。
